purpose: Published disposable off-chain NEP-413 test fixtures; no account or wallet authority

provenance.implementation: Independent fixed-field framing and Node.js built-in OpenSSL crypto; no candidate imports
provenance.ed25519: Fixed public test seed; deterministic Ed25519(SHA256(envelope))
provenance.secp256k1: Fixed public test scalar; Node SHA256 ECDSA over envelope; low-S; randomized signatures
provenance.secp256k1Tail: Zero is only a valid-range verification-profile tail; actual public-key recovery ID is not derived or claimed
provenance.reproducibility: Keys, framing, digests, Ed25519 signatures are reproducible; ECDSA signatures vary on regeneration
